heading: Compile and load errors
text:
## Compile and load errors [LNRE.5]

| Code | Condition | Paragraph |
|---|---|---|
| `DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED` | A regex construct appears anywhere in a program with `regex: false` | [LNRE.3.1], [LFCA.13.1] |
| `DS_ERR_DSC_CAPABILITY_ABSENT` | A DSC whose `requires` lists `regex` is loaded on a runtime built without an RE2-class engine | [LNRE.4.2], [RDSC.16.2.7] |

Neither is specific to `regex`. The first is a compile-time check made
only under `regex: false`. The second is a load-time check a regex-less
runtime always performs, independent of the setting ([LNRE.4.2]).
